- **The host fallback** (`copilotAgentSession._searchToolsOnHost`): the tool-search decision is fixed when the SDK session launches, so a session can outlive the client that runs its search — e.g. an autonomous Agent Merge turn after the window closes. Deferred server and MCP tools need no client to *run*, so when no client can take a search call the override answers it on the host (`searchToolsWithoutClient`) instead of failing the call: it loads the host-runnable deferred tools the query names exactly, leaves out client tools, and tells the model why. When nothing matches, the result lists the loadable names so the model can search again by name. An error result would carry no tool references, so every deferred tool would stay unreachable until the next turn relaunches the session with tool search off. A search already routed to a client that then leaves keeps the failure Agent Host publishes for it, so chat state and the model agree; the next search has no client and takes the fallback.
